Your assumptions only. Compounded illustration, excluding fees and changes in DOGE’s price. Actual returns can vary or be negative. This calculator does not deposit assets or provide privacy.

How does the APY calculation work?+

Illustrative rewards equal balance × ((1 + assumed APY)^(months / 12) − 1). The estimate excludes fees, token-price changes and losses. The rate is your input, not an available or guaranteed yield.

What about ZK privacy?+

A zero-knowledge privacy layer is planned. It is not implemented yet; current Vela transactions are public and are not shielded.
